data.name: Balkrishna
data.gender_notes: Balkrishna is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Balkrishna is a Sanskrit name composed of 'Bal', meaning strength, and 'Krishna', meaning Krishna or God. This name signifies the divine strength and power of Lord Krishna. The name Balkrishna carries the meaning “God's strength in Krishna” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Balkrishna usually hope their child will grow to embody god's strength in krishna and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the inner strength and courage that helps one overcome challenges and lead a virtuous life
data.etymology: Balkrishna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's strength in Krishna.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Balkrishna total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Balkrishna bears a rich cultural heritage in India, particularly among the Hindu community. It is a revered name, reminiscent of the divine figure of Lord Krishna, who is considered as an avatar (god in human form) of the supreme god, Vishnu. Balkrishna is also a common name among the Jains, who believe their founder, Mahavira, was an incarnation of Lord Krishna.
data.spiritual_significance: Balkrishna embodies a deep spiritual connection and resonance with the power and divinity of Lord Krishna. It is a name that symbolizes strength, power, and the divine presence of Lord Krishna in an individual's life. It is believed that those named Balkrishna possess the divine qualities and blessings of Lord Krishna. This name inspires devotion, faith, and spiritual growth, offering a constant reminder of the divine presence and protection.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Balkrishna: The name Balkrishna is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'Bala' (strength) and 'Krishna' (God). It symbolizes the divine strength of Lord Krishna within an individual. This name is believed to bestow the bearer with the divine strength and blessings of Krishna.

vedic_reference.note: The name 'Balkrishna' is derived from Sanskrit words 'Bala' meaning strength and 'Krishna' meaning ball or discus. This name has its origin in Hindu mythology and is often associated with Lord Vishnu and his various avatars.

historical_references.reference: Balkrishna was a prominent leader of the Satavahana dynasty of the Deccan Plateau in ancient India, ruling from around 178 to 191 CE. He is best known for his military conquests, expanding the Satavahana Empire throughout much of India.
historical_references.context: Ancient India, Satavahana Dynasty, Military leader, Expansion of empire

historical_references.reference: Balkrishna was also a renowned Jain monk and philosopher who lived during the 12th century in India. He is considered to be the founder of the Digambara sect of Jainism, and is known for his teachings on non-violence and austerity.
historical_references.context: Medieval India, Jainism, Founder of Digambara sect, Philosophy and teachings
